title: YouTube adds AI tools to Creator Studio with script coaching, smart thumbnails, and Gemini editing
summary: YouTube is adding AI tools to its creator studio. A storytelling assistant analyzes scripts and rough cuts, Gemini becomes a chat-based editing assistant for Shorts, and a new live translation feature turns English streams into Spanish.
